fields.acceptance: New tests in internal/run/fixleaf_test.go with a fake runner as in fixcs_test.go: the leaf fixer fails attempt 1 and passes attempt 2 of cycle 2 and the step passes in 2 cycles with both attempts' sessions recorded apart and the second's judgement before cycle 2's check session; the same with the verifier failing first
fields.statement: A failed review leaf fixer, or its verifier, is retried within its cycle as a fresh fixer and verifier attempt, up to MaxFixCycles more times, and the cycle's checks start only once every leaf fix and the change-set fixer pass

fields.acceptance: A test where the leaf fixer fails all attempts of cycle 2: cycle 2's check outcome starts with cycle 2: fix failed: leaf leaf-a: fixer failed:, no check session starts in cycle 2, and cycle 3 starts a fresh first attempt; TestFixLeafNoCommitFailsCycle and TestFixLeafVerifierFailsCycle are updated to the new session lists
fields.statement: A leaf fixer or verifier failing every attempt of a cycle spends that cycle, and its checks fail with cycle N: fix failed: leaf <handle>: ...
